svg.title: Every measured slowdown, shown once
svg.desc: Each of the 5,940 independently replayed current public slowdowns has its own visible and individually titled dot. Public benchmark only; fresh final test unopened; no final winner.
svg.text: One dot is one current candidate case more than 20% slower than Python. Hover a dot for the exact case.
Every dot is a current measured case; none is sampled, hidden, or copied.
Public benchmark only; fresh final test unopened; no final winner.
